description: INVERT/EE-Lab is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by IREES. Invert/EE-Lab is a techno-economic simulation model following the bottom-up approach, which can be used to determine options for energy demand and its coverage for heating (space heating and hot water) and air conditioning in residential and non-residential buildings and to map the effects of various funding instruments in annual steps. Coverage: Germany. Methodical focus: buildings, final energy demand, technology choices. Time resolution: annual. Spatial resolution: NUTS 3. Software: Python. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the factsheet. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
